item.description:
Memophant 4.0.0

A repo agent that answers questions about your project and proposes fixes you approve, plus wiki and code pages that stay honest about the code they describe.

New

  • Repo agent. Ask questions about your project from the Agent button in the top bar. It reads your code, memory, wiki and tasks, cites its sources, and proposes fixes.
  • Review before anything changes. Approve, reject or edit each proposed fix; nothing is written until you apply, and you can undo until you commit.
  • Agent conversations stay on this Mac and can be exported to Sessions.
  • Documentation-first wiki generator. Pages are written from your code and linked to the files they describe. Text you wrote is merged, never replaced.
  • Review anchors. Confirm suggested code links for existing wiki and code pages from the review inbox, or mark a page "Not tied to code".
  • Verified button on a page flagged because its code changed.
  • "Not tied to code" pages never raise drift warnings.
  • Wiki reading aids: an "On this page" outline, Mermaid diagrams, a reworked sidebar and a broken-link checker.
  • Add Folder / Add Project buttons under the sidebar logo.

Improved

  • Reindexing code no longer freezes the app and is about 10x faster.
  • Far fewer false drift warnings: only pages linked to code that actually changed are flagged.
  • Code overviews link to specific files, and Update refreshes every affected page.
  • The Code section opens on Notes.

Fixed

  • Updating code overviews no longer flags pages as duplicates of themselves; Approve All works.
  • Updates never replace a page the AI didn't read in full or one you just edited.
  • Page actions can no longer resize the window.
  • Adding an already-synced project links to it instead of duplicating it.
